cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your new key is approved for both doors. Come in now; I've made your favorite lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the lock without telling me. Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're discussing the new key. You may test both doors while the food is hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already tested the old one on my birthday. I stood outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I authorize a birthday lunch today. Let yourself into the kitchen; I'll find candles. We can start with a door that opens and a meal together.
